book.name: Yohannisa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Yohannisi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Yesusa Shitto Tiyida Maccassayo
Paaziga ba7aales buro usuppun gallassi attishin Yesusi hayqoppe denththida Alazaarey dizaso Bitaaniya bides.
Heen Yesusas kawo kaththidi Martay iza kawo mizishin izara issife maaddan uttidaytappe issoy Alazaare.
Maarama daro al7o waagara shamettida bagga litiro gidiza geeshsha nardoose shitto ekka yaada Yesusa toho bolla gussada tohoza ba hu7e binanara quccadus. Keeththaaka shitto sawoy kumides.
Yesusa kaallizaytappe issoy Yesusa aaththi immana Asqoronto Yuhuday,
«Hayssi shittozi heedzdzu xeetu dinaares bayzettidi miishshay aazas manqotas imettibeennee?» gides.
Izi hessa giday miish shiishshiza karaxiite oykkizaadey iza gidida gishshas shiiqiza miishshaafe baas shiishshidi go7ettizaade gidida gishshassa attiin manqotas mishettidi gidenna.
Yesusi qasse, «Hayssi shittozi taas moogo gallassas qofettidaaz gidida gishshas he wode gakkanaas iza ba achchan naagu, bochchofte.
Manqoti ay wodekka inttenara deettes. Gido attiin intte tana ubba wode demmeketa» gides.
He wode daro Ayhuda asati Yesusi heen dizayssa eridi izakko yida; yidaytikka Yesusa xalala kosh gidontta Yesusi hayqoppe denththida Alazaarekka beyanaassa.
Hessa gishshas qeeseta halaqati Yesusara Alazaarekka gaththi wodhanaas ba giddon zorettida.
Hessika Alazaare gaason daro Ayhuda asay Yesusaakko bi biidi iza ammaniza gishshassa.
Yesusi Bonchchon Yerusalaame Gelides
Wonteththa gallas ba7aaleza bonchchana yida derey Yesusi Yerusalaame yizayssa siyides.
Zamba hayth ekkidi Yesusa mokkana kezides; derey qaala dhoqqu histtidi, «Hoosa7inna! Godaa sunththan yiza Isra7eele kawoy anjjettidayssa!» gides.
Iza kaallizayti hessa ubbaa koyro wozinan woththibeettenna. Iza gishshas xaafettidayssanne izas oosettida hanokka ubbaa Yesusi hayqoppe dendidaappe guye erida.
Alazaare duufoppe xeygidi hayqoppe denththida wode izara issife diza asay iza denththaa gishshas markkattida.
Daro asikka izi hessa mala gita malaata ooththidayssa siyidi iza mokkana kezides.
Hessa gishshas Farsaaweti ba giddon issoy issaa, «Histtiin nuni ay ooththana dandayzonii? Be7ite! Kumeththa derey attontta iza kaallees» gida.
Yesusi Ba Hayqqanayssa Kaseti Yootides
Goynnanaas ba7aalezas shiiqida asaa giddon Girike dere asatikka deettes.
Isttika Galila giddon diza Betesayda geetettiza dere as Piliphoosa geetettizaadeko biidi, «Godoo! Nu Yesusa beyana koyoos» gida.
Piliphoosikka Indiraasas yootides. Indiraasinne Piliphoosi biidi Yesusas yootida.
Yesusikka isttas, «Hekko Asa Nay bonchchettiza saatey gakkides.
Ta inttes tumu gays; gistte ayfey biittan wodhdhada hayqqontta co7u ga uttiko barkka attawus. Iza hayqqizaa gidikko hara daro ayfawus.
Ba shempo dosizaadey dhayssees. Hayssa biittaa bolla ba shemppo ixxizaadey gidikko mernaa de7o demmees.
Taas ooththana koyzaadey tana kaallo; Taas ooththizaadey ta dizason daana; taas ooththizaade ta Aaway iza bonchchana» gides.
Buroppe Bana Gakkanayssa Gishshas Yesus Yootida Qaala
Qasseka Yesusi, «Hekko ta shemppoya metotadus; ‹Ta Aawawu! Ha saateyppe tana ashsha gooshaa?› Ta hizgontta mala ta yiday hanno ha meto saateyssa.
«Ta Aawawu! Ne sunththaa bonchcha» gides. Hessafe kaallidi, «Tani ta sunththaa bonchchadis; qasseka gujja bonchchana» giza qaalay saloppe yides.
Heen eqqida asay hessa siyidi, «Daday dadatees» gida. Baggayti qasse, «Kiitanchchako haasayzay» gida.
Yesusi, «Hayssi giirissay yiday intte gishshassa attiin ta gishshas gidenna.
Hayssi alamey pirdettana wodey hayssa; hayssa dereza haariza Xala7ey ha7i gede kare yegettana.
Tani dhoqqu gaada kaqettiza wode asaa wursa taakko zaarana» gides.
Yesusi hessa yootiday izi ay mala hayqo hayqqanaakko erisanaassa.
Asay qasse, «Nu wogan xaafettiday, ‹Xoossi kiittidaadey mernaas daana› gees; histtiin ne qasse waanada, ‹Asa Nay dhoqqu gi kaqettana bessees› gay? Ne giza Asa Nay awayssee?» gi oychchida.
Yesusi isttas, «Ha7i guuththa wodes inttenara poo7oy dees; gadey dhumontta poo7ora hemettite; qammara hemettizaadey izi awa bizaakko erenna.
Intte poo7o nayta gidana mala poo7oy dishin poo7on ammanite» gides. Yesusi hessa gidaappe guye biidi istta ayfeppe geemmides.
Ayhudati Ammano Pace
Yesusi isttas hessa mala malaata istta sinththan ooththiinkka Ayhudati izan ammanibeettenna.
Hessi haniday nabe Isayaasi,
Isayaasi hessa giday Xoossi kiittidaade bonchcho be7ida gishshassa; hessa gishshas Yesusi yootides.
Gidikkoka Ayhudata halaqatappe daro asay Yesusa ammanides. Gido attiin istta Ayhudata Woosa Keeththafe gooddontta mala Farsaawetas babbidi ba ammano qonccen markkattibeettenna.
Istti hessaththo haniday isttas Xoossafe imettiza bonchchofe aaththidi asappe imettiza bonchcho dosida gishshassa.
Yesusi ba qaala dhoqqu histtidi, «Tana ammanizaadey tanan xalala gidontta tana kiittidayssanka ammanees.
Tana be7idaadey tana kiittidayssaka beyana.
Tana ammanizay wuri dhuman dontta mala tani poo7o gidada hayssa ha alameza yadis.
Ta qaala siyidi ooththonttaade bolla pirdanay tana gidikke. Gaasoykka ta yiday alame ashshanaas attiin alame bolla pirdanaas gidenna.
Tana koyonttaadenne ta qaala ekkonttaade bolla pirdanaadey dees; ta izas yootida qaalay wurseththa gallas iza bolla pirdana.
Gaasoykka tani coo ta shenen yootabeekke; ta gizayssanne ta yootiza azazo taas immiday tana kiittida ta Aawa.
Iza azazoy mernaa de7o gididayssa ta erays; hessa gishshas ta yootizay wuri Aaway taas yootidayssa» gides.
